beats.heading: Party exit and the four who stay
beats.plot: Ankita ends the New Year's dance outing, checks her home-before-six deadline and declines Vivan and Reyansh's offer to drop her. Sana and Aishwarya remain with them at the venue; no new guests or activities are invented. This handoff preserves Scene06 without reopening the dance.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Mujhe ab chalna hoga. Chhe baje se pehle ghar pahunchna hai.

beats.heading: Two-minute call, final photo and two separate two-wheelers
beats.plot: At the exit Ankita calls Karan and Aman, already nearby, who arrive after about two minutes: Karan on his bike, Aman on his scooty. During the short wait the five office friends take their goodbye group photo. No car arrives. Both brothers have helmets, and no vehicle carries three riders.

dialogue.speaker: Ankita
dialogue.line: Karan, Aman — main venue ke bahar hoon. Aa sakte ho?

beats.heading: First observation and the seating reversal
beats.plot: Karan notices Ankita's confident arrival and the waist-to-hip silhouette of her established cream embroidered kurti and fitted trousers; he makes a playful party-look compliment. Aman notices the outfit but stays quieter. Ankita catches Karan's glance and replies confidently. Karan expects her to ride pillion on his bike, but Ankita elects to drive Aman's scooty herself; Aman rides pillion, while Karan takes his own bike. Karan's expected attention switches to Aman. No outfit change or first meeting is implied.

beats.heading: First clothed waist hold
beats.plot: With Ankita driving Aman's scooty and Aman seated behind, Aman asks to steady himself and initially holds her clothed waist for balance. She acknowledges the ordinary riding support. Karan is on his separate bike and cannot witness every detail of the scooty ride. The changed seating, not a staged accident, creates the new interaction.

beats.heading: Unexpected shift to the stomach and Ankita's response
beats.plot: At a road turn Aman's balancing grip shifts from Ankita's clothed waist toward the stomach area. Ankita immediately notices the unexpected change. She experiences a moment of surprise, heightened physical awareness and conflicting self-consciousness; her internal reaction must not automatically be treated as approval or romantic consent. She adjusts his hand back to a comfortable riding position, and Aman complies. The moment is specific and acknowledged, not a prolonged erotic sequence.

beats.heading: Unequal knowledge and the private after-reaction
beats.plot: Ankita continues driving and reflects briefly on why this unexpected contact felt different from routine familiarity. Aman becomes quieter after correcting his hold. Neither twin is allowed to know her private thoughts from a glance. The event remains between the people on the scooty; Karan only knows he was not her chosen passenger.

beats.heading: Karan's suspicion, not omniscient jealousy
beats.plot: Near the society entrance both vehicles stop safely. Karan notices Ankita and Aman are quieter than before and teases his brother. Aman does not explain the ride moment. Karan senses exclusion and rivalry but has no evidence of an intimate event. Ankita neither confirms a romance nor rewards competition between the brothers. While safely parked before reaching the building, the narrator establishes that Rinku is already Ankita's familiar building helper from regular repairs, small deliveries and errands; no new first meeting, gate conversation or same-day Rinku appearance occurs here.

beats.heading: Gopal silently observes — no follow-up
beats.plot: At the Gulmohar Heights gate Gopal notices Ankita and the twins and briefly looks away in an unusually guarded manner. Ankita catches only a changed expression, not his reader-only parcel secret from EP02 P01–P08. Gopal says NOTHING; Ankita neither questions him nor has a conversation with Mahendra or any other elder. The three proceed home and reach the apartment by ~17:50. Rajeev is away and the private parcel remains in his custody; no handover, inventory check, dinner or meeting. Scene ends at the apartment arrival, before Ankita's 18:10 private reset and Rinku setup.
